_comment_ignorePaths: linux/ is a vendored upstream kernel tree, not our dependency surface. Renovate finds two Python manifests in it -- linux/Documentation/sphinx/requirements.txt and linux/tools/net/ynl/requirements.txt -- and opens PRs to bump the KERNEL's own docs tooling: #1 (Sphinx 2.4.5), #2 (jinja2 <3.2) and #6 (Sphinx 9) all came from that one file, and #1 and #6 contradicted each other. Those versions are upstream's business; bumping them here would diverge our copy from the tree we vendored for no benefit. The default ignorePaths already covers vendor/**, which is why the Go side never produced this noise.
